items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Is that where they called you the Texas Nightingale? ... Everybody wanted to call me the Illinois Songbird.

ctx.x: Is that where they called you the Texas Nightingale? In the Chicago "Defender"?
See, (inaudible) in Chicago. They think (unintelligible) I was born in Texas. Everybody wanted to call me the Illinois Songbird.
